group-2022-yi-seven-choices.overview: 本文是一篇说明文，介绍维持远距离友谊的五种方法。文章以小标题（bullet）领起每个段落，正文紧接展开。七选五的五个空分别落在不同位置：有的是段尾收束句、有的是段首主题句、有的是小标题本身。解题需结合小标题、段内关键词和逻辑/指代衔接综合判断。

discourseStructure.summary: 文章总—分结构：开篇点明远距离友谊需要用心经营，随后用五个带小标题的要点逐条说明，每个要点之间相互独立，靠小标题与段内具体做法形成话题对齐。

units.heading: 导语
units.summary: 总起：友谊需要照料，下面给出维持远距离友谊的五种方法。

units.heading: Set a regular date
units.summary: 要点一：定期联系。双方应平等付出，挤出通话时间，约定固定时间并坚持。

units.heading: More isn’t always merrier
units.summary: 要点二：联系不在多而在合适。先沟通彼此偏好的联系频率与方式，并有多种替代沟通手段。

units.heading: Practise empathy
units.summary: 要点三：共情。无论是离开的一方还是留下的一方，都要体谅对方的处境与感受。

units.heading: Remember important dates
units.summary: 要点四：记住重要日子。纪念日与生日在远距离友谊中尤为重要，记日记追踪日期可避免遗漏。

units.heading: Don’t rely on technology alone
units.summary: 要点五：不要只依赖科技。社交媒体易带来连接感，但远距离友谊需要更主动的努力，尽量面对面相处。

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: With busy schedules, squeezing in phone calls can be a challenge.

mechanismSignals.targetText: find a time ... and stick to it
mechanismSignals.relation: 小标题 Set a regular date 与选项 find a time that works for both of you and stick to it 同属“约定固定时间”话题场。

mechanismSignals.signalText: find a time that works for both of you
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项 find a time 呼应小标题 set a regular date，构成“定时联系”的具体做法。

mechanismSignals.targetText: find a time that works for both of you
mechanismSignals.relation: 空前讲挤时间打电话很难，空处给出对策——找到双方都合适的时间并坚持。

optionFit.fitSummary: 小标题 Set a regular date 点明本段主题是“定期联系”，空前说挤时间打电话很难，空处需收束并给出做法，选项 D“找到双方都合适的时间并坚持”正好对应。

matchedClues.contextSide: Set a regular date / squeezing in phone calls
matchedClues.optionSide: find a time that works for both of you and stick to it
matchedClues.relation: 选项把“定时联系”落到具体做法，承接小标题与空前的时间难题。

keyDistractors.reason: E 谈论沟通方式偏好，与本段“定时间”主题不符，属下一要点 More isn’t always merrier 的内容。

q-2022-yi-036.teachingNote: 段尾空先回看小标题锁定话题，再用选项给出该话题下的具体做法收束全段。

topicClues: how frequently each of you wants to be contacted
what method works best for you both

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: Make sure you have communicated with your friend about how frequently each of you wants to be contacted and what method works best for you both.
contextEvidence.afterQuote: There are alternatives to constant written communication, such as leaving voice messages or having a group chat.

mechanismSignals.signalText: what method works best for you both
mechanismSignals.relation: 空前 what method works best 与选项 preferred methods of communication 同指“偏好的沟通方式”话题场。

mechanismSignals.targetText: how frequently ... what method works best
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项概括空前的“频率/方式”讨论，是 talk about 偏好沟通方式的主题句。
空后列举语音留言、群聊等替代方式，正是 methods of communication 的具体展开。

optionFit.fitSummary: 空前讲要沟通联系频率与最佳方式，空后列举多种替代沟通方式，选项 E“朋友需要谈谈各自偏好的沟通方式”承上启下，正好衔接。

matchedClues.contextSide: what method works best for you both / alternatives to constant written communication
matchedClues.optionSide: talk about their preferred methods of communication
matchedClues.relation: 选项的 methods of communication 既呼应空前 method，又总起空后的多种沟通方式。

keyDistractors.reason: B“通过写信补偿”只涉及单一方式，无法统领空后多种替代沟通方式的列举。

q-2022-yi-037.teachingNote: 段中空要同时照应前后文，选能把空前话题概括、又能领起空后举例的承接句。

topicClues: The one in the new environment

contextEvidence.afterQuote: The friend who is remaining needs to be sensitive to all the additional time demands placed on the friend who has moved.

mechanismSignals.signalText: the friend who left or the one who was left behind
mechanismSignals.targetText: the friend who has moved / The friend who is remaining
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项的“离开者 / 被留下者”与空后 the friend who has moved、The friend who is remaining 一一对应。

mechanismSignals.targetText: the one who was left behind
mechanismSignals.relation: 空后 The friend who is remaining 即选项里“被留下的一方”，与主题句呼应。
空后 the friend who has moved 即选项里“离开的一方”，与主题句呼应。

optionFit.fitSummary: 本段是段首主题空，小标题为 Practise empathy；空后分述“留下的朋友”和“身处新环境的朋友”两种处境，选项 G“你可能是离开的一方，也可能是被留下的一方”正好统领两类对象。

matchedClues.contextSide: The friend who is remaining / the friend who has moved / The one in the new environment
matchedClues.optionSide: the friend who left or the one who was left behind
matchedClues.relation: 选项把空后两种朋友身份提前概括，是典型的段首总起句。

keyDistractors.reason: C“做一个友谊维护者也很有帮助”过于笼统，无法对应空后“离开/留下”两类具体处境。

q-2022-yi-038.teachingNote: 段首空找能统领后文分述对象的总起句，看空后反复出现的并列名词组。

topicClues: friends′ birthdays and other important dates

contextEvidence.afterQuote: Anniversaries and birthdays carry even more weight in long-distance friendships.

mechanismSignals.relation: 选项 Remember important dates 概括空后 Anniversaries、birthdays、important dates，属同一“重要日期”话题场。
空后纪念日与生日正是选项 important dates 的具体例子。
空后 other important dates 与选项 important dates 用词直接复现，锁定小标题。

optionFit.fitSummary: 本空是小标题（bullet）位置，需用一个短语概括整段主题；整段讲纪念日、生日等重要日期及如何用日记追踪，选项 A“记住重要日子”正是该段小标题。

matchedClues.contextSide: Anniversaries and birthdays / important dates / keeping track of
matchedClues.relation: 选项是命令式短语，符合小标题体例，并被段内反复出现的“日期”词汇支持。

keyDistractors.reason: C 是完整陈述句而非短语，不符合小标题（bullet）体例，且内容与“重要日期”话题无关。

q-2022-yi-039.teachingNote: 小标题位置的空要选命令式/名词短语，并由整段反复出现的话题词锁定。

contextEvidence.afterQuote: , but long-distance friendships—even close ones—may require more conscious effort to sustain.

mechanismSignals.targetText: It is easy to have a sense of connectedness through social media
mechanismSignals.relation: 空后以 but 转折，要求空处陈述一个“容易/正面”的事实与之对立，选项 F 提供这一前件。
选项 social media 呼应小标题 technology，点明本要点“不要只依赖科技”。

mechanismSignals.targetText: easy to have a sense of connectedness
mechanismSignals.relation: 空后“需要更主动的努力”与选项“容易获得连接感”形成易↔难对比，正契合 but 的转折。

optionFit.fitSummary: 空后用 but 转折，说远距离友谊需要更主动的努力；空处应给出被转折的一面，选项 F“通过社交媒体很容易获得连接感”既呼应小标题 technology，又与 but 后内容构成“易—难”对比。

matchedClues.contextSide: but ... may require more conscious effort to sustain
matchedClues.optionSide: It is easy to have a sense of connectedness through social media
matchedClues.relation: 选项 easy 与空后 require more conscious effort 形成对比，由 but 连接。

keyDistractors.reason: B“通过写信补偿”不涉及科技/社交媒体，无法与 but 后“依赖科技仍不够”的转折逻辑及小标题 technology 对接。

q-2022-yi-040.teachingNote: 段首空遇空后 but 转折时，选一个与转折内容相反的“前件”句，并让其呼应本段小标题。
